# ACC-2004

- T-001 | refund-request | escalate | Reported duplicate 499.00 USD charges on 30 July; account record showed known duplicate charge issue (CHG-88213) and order history confirmed two orders placed 34 seconds apart.
- T-010 | billing | escalate | Follow-up inquiry on 4 August asking for confirmation that 30 July duplicate charge has been resolved; known issue still in account record, both orders remain delivered.
